body:
All glories to Śrī Guru and Śrī Gaurāṅga

# Kīrtan Guide ### Twelfth Edition

Intended as a useful guide to kīrtans chanted at\ Śrī Chaitanya Sāraswat Maṭh, Nabadwip,\ as established by the Founder President Āchārya\ Śrīla Bhakti Rakṣak Śrīdhar Dev-Goswāmī Mahārāj and his Successor President Āchārya\ Śrīla Bhakti Sundar Govinda Dev-Goswāmī Mahārāj

With standardised transliteration\ and additional selected kīrtans from\ the Maṭh’s original Bengali Śrī Gauḍīya-Gītāñjali ![SCSM Logo](https://github.com/scsm-ua/songbook-resources/blob/main/images/en/1.png?raw=true)
